notes.title: Work Life Balance Demo Update v1.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We’ve just released an update for the demo. The main changes are as follows:
[olist]
Stealth Stage Visual Clarity

Improved scene lighting and contrast to make paths and interactable areas easier to see.

Portrait Display Fix

Resolved an issue where character portraits could display incorrectly after loading from Auto Save.

NPC Pathing Improvements

Upgraded NPC auto-movement logic for smoother, more reliable routing.

macOS Language Update Optimization

Reduced the download size when switching languages on macOS for a smoother experience.

Miscellaneous Fixes

Additional stability and minor bug fixes.
[/olist]
Please update your demo and enjoy the improvements! Your feedback is always welcome.

notes.title: Work Life Balance Demo Update v1.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We’ve just released an update for the demo. The main changes are as follows:

1. Stealth Stage Difficulty Adjustment

Added an option to skip the stage after 5 deaths, allowing players stuck at this part to continue with the story.

2. New Load Option

After failing the stealth stage, you can now choose to load your save directly to reduce repeated attempts.

3. Improved Controller Support

Enhanced controller detection accuracy and improved the wording of controller operation prompts.

4. Art Asset Adjustments

Updated and refined certain art assets in the stealth stage.

5. Bug Fixes

Fixed several known issues to improve overall stability.

Please update your demo and enjoy the improvements! Your feedback is always welcome.
